[[File:Ikari.png|thumb|250px|Ikari]] '''Ikari''' (Japanese: '''イカリ''' ''Ikari'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[SM066|Smashing with Sketch!]]''. His nickname is '''{{m|Dragon Rage}} Ikari''' (Japanese: '''ドラゴンのイカリ''' ''Ikari the Dragon''), because of the draconic vibe he gives off. He is a Pokémon Ping-Pong player and was known for winning the [[Pokémon Ping-Pong tournament]] to become Pokémon Ping-Pong champion of [[Alola]] year after year. During one such competition, he defeated [[Ilima]] in the finals and they formed a rivalry. In the present day, he took part in another tournament. After he reached the finals, he went up against Ilima once more, but was finally defeated. After his defeat, Ikari and Ilima ended their animosity towards one another, as did their Pokémon. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Ikari |pkmn=Mienshao |type1=Fighting |img=Ikari Mienshao.png |epnum=SM066 |epname=Smashing with Sketch! |vajp=Chinami Nishimura |vaen=Kate Bristol |desc={{p|Mienshao}} is Ikari's only known Pokémon. It competed with Ikari in his Pokémon Ping-Pong rematch against [[Ilima]], but was defeated. Mienshao's known moves are {{m|Pound}}, {{m|Drain Punch}}, and {{m|High Jump Kick}}.}} ==Pokémon competitions== Ikari has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Pokémon Ping-Pong tournament]] - Winner, Pokémon Ping-Pong champion of [[Alola]] (one year before ''[[SM066|Smashing with Sketch!]]'') * [[Pokémon Ping-Pong tournament]] - Runner-Up (''[[SM066|Smashing with Sketch!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{fighting color light}}|bordercolor={{fighting color dark}} |ja=沖野晃司 ''Kōji Okino'' |en=[[Wayne Grayson]] |fi=Aku Laitinen |fr_eu=Frédéric Clou |pl=Kamil Pruban}} ==Trivia== * Ikari's character and signature Poké-Ping Pong move is a reference to the character Ryūichi Kazama from the series {{wp|Ping Pong (manga)|Ping Pong}}. * Ikari's name literally translates to "anger", which is a reference to his animosity towards [[Ilima]]. ==Names== {| class="roundy" style="float:left; background:#{{fighting color light}}; border:3px solid #{{fighting color dark}}" |- !
